facts.big: I’d like to order… · What flavor?
facts.label: Encomendar um bolo
facts.sub: Peça com I’d like to order + item. Responda perguntas de flavor e size com palavras curtas: Chocolate. For twelve people. Peça uma mensagem com Can you write … on it?

facts.label: Bolo sob encomenda
facts.sub: Padarias dos EUA fazem bolos sob encomenda. Você escolhe sabor, tamanho e mensagem, e geralmente encomenda com alguns dias de antecedência.

facts.label: Sabores
facts.sub: Os sabores mais comuns são chocolate, baunilha, red velvet e limão. Muitos bolos levam frutas, creme ou cobertura de cream cheese.

pages.title: A cake for Sofia · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Thursday afternoon at a small bakery in Dallas. The shop smells like sugar, butter and vanilla. Bethany walks in with a big smile. “**Hi! I’d like to order a birthday cake,**” she says.
“**Sure. What flavor?**” asks the baker. “**Chocolate, with strawberries,**” says Bethany. “**What size?**” asks the baker. “**For twelve people,**” says Bethany.

pages.title: A cake for Sofia · 2/3
paragraphs: “**That’s a large cake,**” says the baker. “It’s for my daughter’s party on Saturday,” says Bethany. “**Can you write a name on it?**” she asks. “**Of course. What name?**” asks the baker.
“**Happy Birthday, Sofia,**” says Bethany. The baker writes the name on a small card. “Pick up on Saturday at nine. It’s fifty dollars,” he says. Bethany pays a deposit of twenty dollars.

pages.title: A cake for Sofia · 3/3
paragraphs: On Saturday, Bethany picks up the cake. It is big and brown, with one fresh strawberry for each slice. The strawberry on top looks very sweet. She smiles and carries the box to the car very carefully. “It’s perfect! Thank you so much,” she says. At the party, Sofia blows out twelve candles. Everybody sings, and the cake is gone in ten minutes.

pages.title: Laboratório de sons · o som
pages.what: O V do inglês é feito com os dentes de cima no lábio de baixo. Muitos trocam por “f” ou “b” (“flafor”, “banilla”).
pages.how: Encoste os dentes de cima no lábio de baixo e faça a voz vibrar: “vvv”. Em flavor, o primeiro som é F, e o V vem na segunda sílaba.
pages.tip: Coloque a mão no pescoço: no V você sente vibração, no F não.
